mapper.sql: SELECT g.id, g.menu_key, g.grantee_type, g.user_id, g.team_id, u.name AS user_name, ut.name AS user_team_name, u.job_title AS user_job_title, u.active AS user_active, t.name AS team_name, t.leader_user_id, l.name AS leader_name, g.granted_by, gb.name AS granted_by_name, g.created_at FROM admin_menu_grants g LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = g.user_id LEFT JOIN teams ut ON ut.id = u.team_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = g.team_id LEFT JOIN users l ON l.id = t.leader_user_id LEFT JOIN users gb ON gb.id = g.granted_by
mapper.select: ORDER BY g.menu_key, g.grantee_type DESC, COALESCE(t.name, u.name)

SELECT DISTINCT g.menu_key FROM admin_menu_grants g LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = g.team_id WHERE (g.grantee_type = 'USER' AND g.user_id = #{userId}) OR (g.grantee_type = 'TEAM_LEADER' AND t.active = 1 AND t.leader_user_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO admin_menu_grants(menu_key, grantee_type, user_id, team_id, granted_by) VALUES(#{menuKey}, #{granteeType}, #{userId}, #{teamId}, #{grantedBy})

INSERT INTO admin_menu_grant_logs(menu_key, action, grantee_type, user_id, team_id, grantee_label, actor_id, actor_name) VALUES(#{menuKey}, #{action}, #{granteeType}, #{userId}, #{teamId}, #{granteeLabel}, #{actorId}, #{actorName})
